name: When The World Will End
overview: Jesus teaches that no one knows the exact day or hour when the world will end, emphasizing that only the Father in heaven has that knowledge (Matthew 24:36). Believers are warned to be vigilant and watchful, as the timing of His coming is unknown (Matthew 24:42). The disciples’ questions about the signs of the end times are met with caution against deception, as false Christs and prophets will arise to mislead many, even the elect if possible (Matthew 24:3-4, 24). Jesus also uses the parable of the fig tree to illustrate that certain signs will indicate the nearness of the end, encouraging discernment and readiness (Matthew 24:32).
